g1-census.title: Census: classify every check-shaped script live/unwired/dead
g1-census.imperative: REASONING GATE, crew-waived: this dispatched context carries no Task/Agent tool (Bash, Read, Write, Edit, WebFetch, WebSearch, Skill only), so no gN-implement/gN-review crew can be raised; driven directly in this context per commander-core.md 'Crew gate vs reasoning gate'. For every scripts/{verify,check,prove,measure}_*.py (26 at base commit 244665ee), determine live / unwired / dead using a uniform check sequence (PLAN_CRITIC finding 1): grep skills/*/templates/*.json for a command-kind check block naming the script; grep .github/workflows/*.yml; grep scripts/hooks/; grep tests/ for a direct call/import; grep scripts/ for a cross-script subprocess/import call; check episodes/ and the read-only main-checkout .agent-work/ for evidence the script ran in anger. Write docs/CHECK_SCRIPT_CENSUS.md: one markdown table, one row per script, columns Script | Classification | Evidence, plus a header stating the exact check sequence applied (PLAN_CRITIC finding 6) so each row is reproducible. Commit it.

postconditions.statement: docs/CHECK_SCRIPT_CENSUS.md exists, is committed, and has exactly 26 classified script rows (one per scripts/{verify,check,prove,measure}_*.py at base commit)

g3-field-groups.imperative: REASONING GATE, crew-waived (same reason as g1). g4-disposition.title: Disposition: execute exactly the outcome the census supports, and report map impact
g4-disposition.imperative: REASONING-then-mechanical GATE, crew-waived (same reason as g1; also no crew dispatch was available to separate implement/review, so this Commander runs the change and its own verification directly). Per PLAN_CRITIC finding 4, execute exactly ONE of the three Honest-Null-Clause outcomes the g1-g3 evidence supports -- not a blend chosen ad hoc: (a) population mostly unwired -> author the smallest lint per decision:registration-lint-shape (option 1 registration lint or option 2 vocabulary rule, never option 3), wire it somewhere it can fail (a command check in a shipped template, or a pytest test, or a CI job -- decision:no-new-unwired-checker), and prove a reproducible negative case; if report-only, name its promotion trigger in the same PR (decision:report-only-names-its-trigger); (b) population mostly dead -> delete the dead scripts, evidence row per deletion, ship no lint; (c) mixed -> do both, stating which scripts got which treatment. Per PLAN_CRITIC finding 5, re-run the full local pytest suite (not just a targeted subset) after any change and paste its summary line. Report map impact: whether map/INDEX.md or docs/architecture/ need reconciling -- given the Mission Frame's Map Confidence finding (map/ids.jsonl and docs/architecture/generated/map.json are both empty at this revision, not merely stale), state plainly whether that gap is itself worth a triage candidate rather than attempting a reconciliation against a map that does not exist. Commit the disposition (deletions and/or new lint file) plus the RESULT.md draft.
